description: This file defines the NNCrypto class which provides cryptographic functionalities such as encryption, decryption, hashing, key derivation, and stream creation, utilizing the Sodium library and related modules within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: NNCrypto
classes.description: A class providing cryptographic operations such as encryption, decryption, hashing, key derivation, and stream handling, using Sodium library.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Sodium library asynchronously if not already initialized.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data with a serialized key and specified data format, returning a ciphertext in the desired output format.

methods.name: encryptMulti
methods.description: Encrypts multiple data items with a serialized key, returning an array of ciphertexts.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext data with a serialized key, returning the output in the specified format.

methods.name: decryptMulti
methods.description: Decrypts multiple ciphertexts with a serialized key, returning an array of decrypted outputs.

methods.name: decryptAsymmetric
methods.description: Performs asymmetric decryption using a key pair and ciphertext, returning the decrypted output.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a hash from a password and salt.

methods.name: deriveKey
methods.description: Derives an encryption key from a password and optional salt.

methods.name: deriveKeyPair
methods.description: Derives a public/private key pair for encryption.

methods.name: exportKey
methods.description: Exports a serialized key from a password and optional salt.

methods.name: createEncryptionStream
methods.description: Creates an encryption stream with a serialized key.

methods.name: createDecryptionStream
methods.description: Creates a decryption stream with a serialized key and IV.
